Specification: This specification models a very small state machine over a single variable x. The initial state allows x to start in either "a" or "b", and uses TLC's Print operator to emit a message explaining that the specification can deadlock but that simulation mode should not report that deadlock. The transition relation Next permits steps from "b" to "c", from "c" to "d", and a self-loop on "d" that invokes Assert(FALSE, "Test successfully completed."), so the model is intended as a TLC test rather than a complete temporal specification with verified safety or liveness properties.
FunctionApplication: Print("This spec can deadlock, but shouldn't.", TRUE)
StringLiterals: This spec can deadlock, but shouldn't.
